question: In which text is the remembered one located, O lady of the world and Īśānī?
premises: The remembered one is in Rudrayāmala
The addressee is lady of the world and Īśānī
inference: The verse locates the remembered one in Rudrayāmala.
plain_english: O lady of the world, O Īśānī, the remembered one is indeed in the Rudrayāmala.
